[uncountable] WordReference Random House Unabridged Dictionary of American English © 2026gauche (gōsh),USA pronunciation adj. lacking social grace, sensitivity, or acuteness; awkward; crude; tactless:Their exquisite manners always make me feel gauche. Gmc French: awkward, left; Middle French, derivative of gauchir to turn, veer 1745–55 gauche′ly, adv. gauche′ness, n. inept, clumsy, maladroit; coarse, gross, uncouth.
